section_summary.extract_value: This section describes one participant sample of women recruited from a private university in Ribeirão Preto, São Paulo, Brazil, with an initial pool of 200 and 6 exclusions, leaving 194 participants. The remaining sample had a mean age of 21.80 years (SD = 4.24), a mean BMI of 23.99 kg/m2 (SD = 4.94), and 88.7% self-reported as ethnically White. No study label (e.g., 'Study 1') is used and no information is provided on survey method, education percentages, BA assessment instrument, BMI assessment method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
